title: Trust Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trust:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day trust metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on trust metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your trust metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
